author: cskiraly
content: Before I get critisized for the writeup quality, here I admit publicly that it was prepared in a hurry. We (me and many others) have been working on fast large message diffusion (for blocks as the main target, obviously) for a long time. I'm now on EL, so this was not my first priority, but not seeing it proposed for Hegota in a clear and focused form is I think a huge missed opportunity that we can and should correct, if there is agreement on it. So I did the new simulations and writeup with go-libp2p. My old simulations were using nim-libp2p as a sideproduct of DAS work (segment, erasure code, but don't sample), and showed good results too.

author: ansgar.eth
content:
> not seeing it proposed for Hegota in a clear and focused form is I think a huge missed opportunity that we can and should correct

I tend to agree with this sentiment. But I also think having a feature of this size rushed to EIP already past proposal deadline is really not ideal. We would in practice end up again agreeing to ship something that at decision time is still in early draft stage - historically, I think those are the features that delay hard forks and that we end up regretting.

I'd rather make sure we have this ready for I*, but if CL devs feel strongly about considering this for Hegota, it doesn't seem insane to do so.
